notes: Settings: a Close game button that saves and quits.

Mart: sell spare held items, role items, evolution items and Mega Stones from Bag & Sell (thanks foxelina and hypergon!). Held and evolution items sell for a quarter of the Mart price, Mega Stones for $2,000 and legendary items (Red Orb, Mewtwonite…) for $5,000. Items your Pokémon are holding stay on them, and big sales ask first.

Branching evolutions are your pick now: Eevee, Tyrogue, Wurmple, Slowpoke, Kirlia, Snorunt, Nincada and the rest never evolve on their own. When one is ready, the PC shows its arrow and the Evolution tab lets you choose.
changes: Online is much lighter on the server: the game checks in less often when you’re away from it, so friends, trades and raids stay up for everyone.
Raids need the online connection now, so every raid is saved on the server. If raids are taking a break, the raid screen says so.
fixes: Raids start much faster, and show a loading screen instead of looking stuck.
Friends: the PC and gift buttons no longer vanish when the server is busy, and a friend’s PC shows a loading screen (and Try again) instead of staying empty.
Update required: the card now links our Discord.
Islands: sleeping Legends now say what wakes them. Since 0.51 wild Legendaries need 3 Gym badges as well as the island’s own, and the card only said “beat the Gym” (thanks kiki, doctor and truffle!).
Battle Tower and trainer battles: the type badge now changes with each Pokémon the foe sends out (a Dratini showed the first Pokémon’s Steel / Dragon, thanks legragon!).
PC search: “mega” now finds your Mega Stone holders only, not every Pokémon that knows Mega Drain or Megahorn (thanks iwrecked22!).
Classic layout: clicking your Buddy in the scene plays with it instead of grabbing the window (thanks hypergon!).
Settings: in the Classic layout the strip Size is greyed out with a note (Classic has no strip: drag the window’s edges to size it, thanks sato!).
Friends: adding a friend while the server is busy now says so, instead of “No trainer with that code”.
Night Market: a Pokémon from a newer version of the game now waits safely in your market mail until you update.
Eggs: a hatched baby waiting for its reveal no longer levels up or evolves before you see it (bred Eevees came out as Espeon or Umbreon).

title: Raid Eggs every raid
notes: Raid Eggs on every raid, won or lost: 1 to 5 by YOUR damage (1 egg, 2 from 10,000, 3 from 20,000, 4 from 35,000 and 5 from 50,000).
Master Ball: any raid where your damage reaches 50,000 gives a Master Ball, every time, win or lose. Look for it on the last step of the egg meter.
Beat the boss with your party for the bonus on top: money, Rare Candy, its Candy, Bounty Tickets (and a Mega raid’s Mega Stone).
Day Care: a new filter shows only Pokémon that can breed with the one already in the pen (thanks Kredithai!).
Wonder Trade is now always with real players: throw a Pokémon into the pool and get a random one back from another trainer.
Wonder Trade: spare Shinies and other specials can go in the pool now (you always keep your best one).
Mart: you can now sell spare Poké Balls and Great Balls (thanks foxelina!).
Settings: new Hardware acceleration switch, turn it off if the game crashes on your PC.
Updates now download by themselves in the background, so you’re always on the latest version.
changes: Shiny, Umbral and Prismana Pokémon are rarer now (3× in the wild, 2× from eggs), so every one you find really means something.
One 5★ raid boss at a time: a new Legendary or Mythical every day at midnight UTC.
Every raid uses its Raid Pass, won or lost (you always get eggs now). Still 10 free passes a day.
The top-damage Master Ball is gone: the 50,000 damage Master Ball replaces it.
Wild legendaries are rarer now: Raids are the place to farm them.
fixes: Raid results: each Pokémon’s damage now adds up to Your damage exactly.
Starting raids back to back could replay the same fight: every raid is a new battle now.
Fixed the game only showing part of the screen on some multi-monitor setups.
Fixed speed skip sometimes crediting fewer fights than it skipped (thanks angethemessager!).
Classic layout: the folded window now reaches every screen edge, and edges are less magnetic (a maximised window drags back easily).
Catch rules: New looks now means looks you’ve never had, so it stops catching Pokémon you evolved or traded away.

title: Raids 2.0
notes: Raids 2.0: your own raid boss with its own HP. Eight bosses are up at once: four 5★ Legendaries, a 5★ Mythical, a Mega raid, a 3★ and a 1★ raid. Each stays for 2 days, then the next one takes its spot, and every boss comes back later.
Raid Passes: 10 free every day (new ones at midnight UTC). One pass = one raid. If your party doesn’t beat the boss, you get the pass back.

Raid party: you + 3 helpers. Trainers near your level who raided the same boss lately help with their own squad (friends first), and a Raid Ranger fills any empty spot. Beat the boss’s HP together inside one battle to win.

Raid Eggs: win and you get 1 to 5 Raid Eggs by YOUR damage: 1 egg, 2 from 10,000, 3 from 20,000, 4 from 35,000 and 5 from 50,000. Every egg rolls its own Shiny, Umbral, Prismana and perfect IV chances. Hatch them at the Day Care.
Mega raids: the first win while one is up gives you its Mega Stone. Top damage in your party (with a helper) on your first win of the day gives a Master Ball.
The raid screen shows how many eggs your squad should get and whether your party can win, and the battle shows your helpers and your egg meter live.
changes: Wild Legendaries are rarer now (about a third as common) and only roam once you have 3 badges: Raids are the place to farm them.
Raid Eggs of the same kind stack in the Egg basket, so lots of them never crowd it.
Raid Eggs you earned in the old shared raids can still be claimed on the raid screen.
fixes: Classic layout: the folded window now reaches every screen edge, and edges are less magnetic (a maximised window drags back easily).
Catch rules: New looks now means looks you’ve never had, so it stops catching Pokémon you evolved or traded away.
